st: Arnold Betrays Iggy/Helga and the Nanny
d: Arnold accidentally breaks a promise he made to Iggy and must deal with the consequences. / Big Bob hires a nanny for Helga. Helga fights the nanny at her own game and forces her to leave.

Arnold becomes a hot (and dangerous) hitter. He keeps injuring people every time he swings the bat. Afraid of hurting more people, Arnold refuses to play ball. / Arnold and Gerald manage the career of the unlikely country-and-western singer, Mr. Hyunh.
Arnold lends Sid his room for one evening, but the arrangement backfires when Sid keeps on borrowing the room. / Helga and Patty (the big girl) face off.

All the kids are paired with adults with interesting jobs except Arnold, who is forced to spend time with the Jolly Olly Man. / Harold believes it's his life's calling to become a butcher, but he slowly drives Mr. Greene, the butcher, crazy.

Casa Paradiso/Gerald''s Tonsils: Grandpa becomes tired of dealing with the boarding house and decides to sell./Gerald has his tonsils removed before a big concert and must come to grips with the fact that his voice has changed.

st: Phoebe Takes the Fall/The Pig War
d: Phoebe Takes the Fall/The Pig War: Phoebe agrees to take a dive so that Helga can win a competition./The boys engage in a recreation of a historical battle, only this time their prized pig is in danger of losing his life.
Best Man/Cool Party: The Coach wants to remarry Tish and asks Arnold to be his best man./ Rhonda has a party and only invites the cool kids.
Sid''s Revenge/Roller Coaster: After Arnold accidentally embarrasses Sid, Sid seeks revenge./ Eugene wants to ride with the gang, but they all think he''s a jinx and won''t go with him.

Grandpa's Birthday/Road Trip: Grandpa thinks he's going to die soon because no one in his family ever made it past his age. He prepares to die, and Arnold tries to convince him that life is still worth living.

Arnold and Lila/Grand Prix: Helga, lost in a love reverie, writes "Arnold loves Helga" on a wall, but changes the name to "Lila" when the kids approach.  Lila thinks that Arnold loves her until he explains the mistake.

Girl Trouble/School Dance: Arnold tells Grandpa he''s tired of dealing with Helga''s nonsense.  Grandpa tells Arnold a story about a girl he had to deal with when he was a kid who treated him the same way.  She turns out to be Grandma.

Helga's Show/Flood: Helga does a standup routine at a school function and proceeds to insult all of her friends.  They are offended, prompting her to change her act to a more friendly and gentle routine.  She performs the new act, but it's boring.
Arnold and Helga perform a \"Romeo and Juliet\"- type play for a school production
At the Parent's Day competition, Arnold learns that even though he doesn't have \"real\" parents, his grandparents are just as good as everyone else's parents.

Eugene's Birthday: Arnold is the cause of two birthday party's for Eugene being a big flop.
Stinky's Pumpkin: Stinky feels that he is a failure at everything he does until Arnold helps him discover that he is the best pumpkin grower in town.

t: Hey Arnold!: Dinner for Four/Phoebe Skips
d:
Dinner for Four: After winning coupons to a fancy French restaurant, Helga attempts to prove to Arnold that she is more sophisticated than Lila. 
Phoebe Skips: Helga is devastated when her patsy, Phoebe, is skipped to the 6th grade.

Full moon: When the gang all decide that they are going to "moon" Principal Wartz, Arnold thinks that it's a bad idea, but ends up inadvertently getting caught and taking the blame.
Student Teacher: Olga comes to PS 118 to be a student teacher.

t: Hey Arnold!: Big Gino/Jamie O in Luv
d:
Big Gino: Sid gets in over his head when doing business with the local kid loan shark, Big Gino.
Jamie O in Luv: Gerald's big brother, Jamie O, falls for a girl and suddenly turns nice to his kid brother.

t: Hey Arnold!: Beeper Queen/Oscar Can't Read?
d:
Beeper Queen: Big Bob pulls his back and cannot go to a very important meeting. Not knowing who else to send in his place, he asks Helga.
Oscar Can't Read?: When Arnold discovers that Oskar has been pretending to know how to read, Arnold confronts him.

t: Hey Arnold!: The Headless Cabbie/Friday the 13th
d:
The Headless Cabbie: Wolfgang dares Arnold and the gang to break superstitions, which causes a spate of bad luck to erupt.
Friday the 13th: At a sleepover, Arnold and the boys sit around and tell scary stories.

Helga's Parrot: Big Bob gets a pesky parrot he passes to Helga, who confides in it about Arnold.
Chocolate Turtles: Arnold and Gerald sell chocolate turtles to fund their go-cart project.

t: Hey Arnold!: Love and Cheese/Weighing Harold
d:
Love and Cheese: Arnold goes all out to win Lila's affection by taking her to the Annual Cheese Festival.
Weighing Harold: Harold feels that he has gotten too fat, so he gets his parents to send him on a weight-off cruise.

It Girl: Helga becomes the latest child fashion star and everyone loves her for her scowl and bad attitude.
Deconstructing Arnold: The gang finally gets sick of Arnold's never-ending good advice, so they all decide to stop listening to him all together.

Grudge Match: Arnold and Grandpa vs Helga and Big Bob in a fender bender blame game.
Polishing Rhonda: Rhonda and Patty's rivalry heats up at finishing school.

t: Hey Arnold!: Back to School/Egg Story
d:
Back To School: Grandpa returns to grade school so he can finally fulfill his dream of graduating.
Egg Story: Mr. Simmons gives the class an assignment to couple up and take care of an egg over the weekend to learn teamwork and responsibility.

Weird Cousin: Arnold's weird cousin, Arnie, arrives for a visit and appears to be the biggest loser to everyone except Lila, the love of Arnold's life.
Baby Oskar: Oskar's wife Susie agrees to watch her cousin's baby, also named Oskar.

Helga Sleepwalks: Helga begins to sleepwalk and ends up walking to Arnold's house. 
Fighting Families: The Fighting Families Contest has come to town and have selected two families: one from PS 118 and PS 119.

Monkeyman!: Arnold is saved from thugs by a mysterious, caped character named Monkeyman.
Buses, Bikes, Subways: Out on a field trip, Harold and Helga miss the bus and get separated from the rest of the class.

Grandpa's sister: Mitzi arrives unexpectedly at the boarding house.
Synchronized Swimming: Coach Wittenberg recruits Arnold's gang for a synchronized swim team.

t: Hey Arnold!: Helga's Masquerade/Mr. Green Runs
d:
Helga's Masquerade: When Helga realizes that Arnold is so taken by Lila because of her wit and charm, she decides that the only way to get Arnold to notice her is to be like Lila.
Mr. Green Runs: Arnold helps Mr. Green run for the City Council.

t: Hey Arnold!: Helga On The Couch
d: Helga is recommended for counseling after Mr. Simmons observes her berating Arnold, arguing with her parents, etc. She learns that unrequited love is very normal and that she's actually okay.

Washed up balladeer Dino Spumoni fakes his own death in order to increase his record sales.  Everyone believes he's dead and at the funeral, Grandpa and Arnold find out that Dino has left Arnold all his future record sales.
By complete coincidence, Arnold and Helga and family end up at the same beach resort for summer vacation. Helga is ecstatic until Arnold meets Summer, the girl of his dreams.
After a chilling vampire movie, Sid is so spooked that he believes that Stinky has all of the characteristics of a vampire. Olga comes home and wants to be a big sister to a little girl.
